name: Event manager
summary: Plans events and trade shows from budget to run sheet and makes sure every lead or guest is followed up.

changelog.note: First release: briefs, budgets and countdown timelines, venue and supplier contract terms, run sheets, UK licensing and Martyn's Law, accessibility (ADA, UK guidance, EU), allergens, attendee data and follow-up rules, trade shows and no-show data, 29 checked sources, 4 skills, 6 prompts, 3 workflows.
